findings: 2026-11-05: drafted for Mathematics 11 Unit 7 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.

Book correction: Example 5(b): the book prints "= 3! \cdot 24 \cdot 6 \cdot 2 \cdot 6"; the 3! in front is a misprint. Correct: 4! \cdot 3! \cdot 2! \cdot 3! = 24 \cdot 6 \cdot 2 \cdot 6 = 1728 ways. Example 5(a), figure: the printed shelf shows only one chemistry book (8 books). There are 2 chemistry books, 9 books in all; our figure shows all nine.

Book correction: Example 6(c): the book prints "= 5! 48 = 120 48 = 72 way"; the minus signs are missing. Correct: 5! - 48 = 120 - 48 = 72 ways. Example 6, figures: in (a) only four chairs (A, B, C, D) are drawn for 5 people, and in (b) the chairs are labelled C, D, D; the last should be E. Our figure shows five seats A, B, C, D, E.
